mapper.select: SELECT TblSalesMaster.SalesDate AS salesDate, (TblSalesMaster.Cost - ISNULL(TblExpend.Cost, 0)) AS cost FROM ( SELECT CONVERT(CHAR(10), SalesDate, 23) SalesDate, SUM(Cost) Cost FROM SalesMaster WHERE SalesYn = 'Y' AND SalesDate BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY CONVERT(CHAR(10), SalesDate, 23) ) TblSalesMaster LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT CONVERT(CHAR(10), ExpendDate, 23) ExpendDate, SUM(Cost) Cost FROM Expend WHERE ExpendDate BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY CONVERT(CHAR(10), ExpendDate, 23) ) TblExpend ON TblExpend.ExpendDate = TblSalesMaster.SalesDate ORDER BY TblSalesMaster.SalesDate

SELECT TblSalesMaster.SalesDate AS salesDate, (TblSalesMaster.Cost - ISNULL(TblExpend.Cost, 0)) AS cost FROM ( SELECT LEFT(CONVERT(CHAR(10), SalesDate, 23), 7) SalesDate, SUM(Cost) Cost FROM SalesMaster WHERE SalesYn = 'Y' AND SalesDate BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY LEFT(CONVERT(CHAR(10), SalesDate, 23), 7) ) TblSalesMaster LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT LEFT(CONVERT(CHAR(10), ExpendDate, 23), 7) ExpendDate, SUM(Cost) Cost FROM Expend WHERE ExpendDate BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY LEFT(CONVERT(CHAR(10), ExpendDate, 23), 7) ) TblExpend ON TblExpend.ExpendDate = TblSalesMaster.SalesDate ORDER BY TblSalesMaster.SalesDate

SELECT (TblSalesMaster.SalesDate + '-01-01') AS salesDate, (TblSalesMaster.Cost - ISNULL(TblExpend.Cost, 0)) AS cost FROM ( SELECT LEFT(CONVERT(CHAR(10), SalesDate, 23), 4) SalesDate, SUM(Cost) Cost FROM SalesMaster WHERE SalesYn = 'Y' AND SalesDate BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY LEFT(CONVERT(CHAR(10), SalesDate, 23), 4) ) TblSalesMaster LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT LEFT(CONVERT(CHAR(10), ExpendDate, 23), 4) ExpendDate, SUM(Cost) Cost FROM Expend WHERE ExpendDate BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY LEFT(CONVERT(CHAR(10), ExpendDate, 23), 4) ) TblExpend ON TblExpend.ExpendDate = TblSalesMaster.SalesDate ORDER BY TblSalesMaster.SalesDate

SELECT CONVERT(CHAR(10), SalesDate, 23) AS salesDate, SalesNo AS salesNo, '수입' AS salesType, CustCode AS custCode, Qty AS qty, Discount AS discount, '' AS expendCode, Cost AS cost, Status AS status, BankingYn AS bankingYn FROM SalesMaster WHERE SalesYn = 'Y' AND CONVERT(CHAR(10), SalesDate, 23) = #{salesDate} UNION ALL SELECT CONVERT(CHAR(10), ExpendDate, 23) AS salesDate, CONVERT(VARCHAR(11), IDX) AS salesNo, '지출' AS salesType, '' AS custCode, 0 AS qty, 0 AS discount, ExpendCode AS expendCode, -Cost AS cost, '' AS status, '' AS bankingYn FROM Expend WHERE CONVERT(CHAR(10), ExpendDate, 23) = #{salesDate} ORDER BY salesDate DESC, salesNo DESC
